test_title: RRB Group D Previous Year Paper (Held on: 15 Sept 2022 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Five persons are sitting around a circular table facing the centre. Robin is an immediate neighbour of both Sudhakar and Rudra. Rajesh is sitting second to the left of Robin. Rudra is sitting second to the right of Sudhakar. Ramesh is an immediate neighbour of both Rajesh and Rudra. Who is an immediate neighbour of both Ramesh and Robin?
solution: **Given: **Five persons are sitting around a circular table facing the centre. 1) Rajesh is sitting second to the left of Robin. 2) Ramesh is an immediate neighbour of both Rajesh and Rudra.
